name: Phoenix (Oracle Mystery)
body:
Class Skills: An oracle with the phoenix mystery adds Fly, Intimidate, Perception, and Knowledge (nature) to her list of class skills.

Bonus Spells: touch of combustion (2nd), spontaneous immolation (4th), trial by fire (6th), healing flame (8th), cleansing fire (10th), resurrection (12th), fire storm (14th), incendiary cloud (16th), fiery body (18th)

Revelations

An oracle with the phoenix mystery can choose from any of the following revelations.

Born Into Flame (Ex)

You gain resist fire 5. This resistance increases to 10 at 5th level and 20 at 11th level.

At 17th level, you gain immunity to fire.

Channel Fire (Su)

You gain the ability to channel fire, as the cleric variant channeling ability of the same name, using your oracle level to determine your effective cleric level for the purpose of her channel energy ability.

You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Charisma modifier.

Flaming Spells (Su)

You gain Flaring Spell as a bonus feat. In addition, once per day, you can cast a spell with the Flaring Spell metamagic feat as a standard action that does not increase the level of the spell. You can only apply the feat to spells with the fire or light descriptor.

You can use this ability one additional time per day at 7th level and every 4 levels thereafter.

Form of the Phoenix (Su)

You must be at least 19th level to select this revelation.

As a standard action, you can assume the form of a phoenix, as per form of the phoenix (see below). You can use this ability once per day, but the duration is 10 minutes per oracle level.

Knowledge of the Ages (Su)

You can accede to the memories of a phoenix’s many lives. You can retry any Knowledge skill check you have made within the past minute, gaining an insight bonus on the check equal to your Charisma modifier.

You can use this ability a number times per day equal to your Charisma modifier.

Phoenix Senses (Ex)

The eyes of a phoenix see beyond the limits of mortal sight. You gain either darkvision with a range of 60 feet or low-light vision. At 5th level, you can select darkvision with a range of 60 feet or low-light vision if you do not yet have both, or you can add 30 feet to the range of your darkvision.

At 11th level, you gain a +4 bonus on Perception checks.

At 15th level, this bonus increases to +8.

Rejuvenating Touch (Su)

Your touch brings living creatures back to their inexperienced youth. As a melee touch attack, you can deal 1 point of Wisdom damage for every two oracle levels you possess (minimum 1) to living creatures.

Alternatively, you can use this power to counter and dispel magical aging effects, such as sands of time. You can use this ability once per day, plus one additional time per day for every five oracle levels you possess.

Renewal In Fire (Su)

Your fire magic serves the power of life as well as destruction. Whenever you cast a spell with the fire descriptor, you may choose to deal damage only to evil creatures and instead heal good creatures of the same amount of hit points, as per the Elemental Healing feat (see below). A spell cast this way is considered to belong to the conjuration (healing) school instead of its normal school, and gains the good descriptor.

Touch of Flame (Su)

As a standard action, you can perform a melee touch attack that deals 1d6 points of fire damage +1 point for every two oracle levels you possess. You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Charisma modifier.

At 11th level, any weapon that you wield is treated as a flaming weapon.

Wings of the Phoenix (Su)

You must be at least 7th level before selecting this revelation.

As a swift action, you can manifest a pair of fiery wings that grant you a fly speed of 60 feet with good maneuverability. You can use these wings for 1 minute per day per oracle level. This duration does not need to be consecutive, but it must be spent in 1 minute increments.

Final Revelation

Upon achieving 20th level, you become one with the spirit of legendary phoenix. You receive a bonus on all saving throws equal to your Charisma modifier. You become immune to death effects, fire and negative energy.

If you have the wings of the phoenix revelation, you may use it at will. Should you die, you are reborn 3 days later as a resplendent infant that matures over the course of 7 days (treat as the reincarnate spell).
